This is a template for creating a new repository for data analysis-based
research projects done within DP-Next. We use this template to quickly get
started with a repository that has everything needed for doing research projects
that follows how we (hope to) work in DP-Next.

## Features

- Sets the project up as an [R](https://r-project.org) Project.
- Uses the [CC-BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) license.
- Uses a GitHub workflow to automatically add pull requests and issues to a
  project board.

## Want to contribute?

We would love your feedback or contributions! Head over to our [GitHub
repository]({{< meta links.github >}}) to share your ideas or contribute code.
Your input makes us better!
